content.instructions: Choose the one correct answer for each question.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses a separable verb correctly?
options: Ich stehe auf um sieben Uhr.
questions.explanation: The prefix goes to the very end of the main clause.
“halb” counts towards the next hour: halfway to three is 2:30.

questions.prompt: Which sentence says you have to work today?
Which sentence has the verb in the right place?
questions.explanation: The verb is always in second position in a statement; the subject moves behind it.
